scientific_integrity: A direct analytic proof is supplied. Numerical checks corroborate but do not replace proof; earlier mutual-neighbor frequency and typical-cell marginals are expressly attributed to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous Poisson process on the real line only; one ordered adjacent pair under point Palm sampling; prior general Palm literature may imply this result; independence and external validation not asserted.
title: Coupled Voronoi lengths of mutual nearest-neighbor pairs in a Poisson line
